text:
sara: Heads-up — the new 13B-quant eval run started hitting shard reassignment timeouts and queue depth spikes. CI reruns are getting noisy. Anyone else seeing this?

ajay: Yep, saw it. Runner logs show repeated "lease not found" and "enqueue timeout" coming from eval-runner-3.

maria: Telemetry: shard-7 persistent queue occ ~90% for >6m, but GPU util is low (~20%). Heap for the worker looks fine.

dave: My hunch is warmup/quantize pass adding a long tail on first requests (KV cache miss + quant init). That stretches lease windows and triggers reassignment.

sara: That fits. The run profile has a lot of small batches early. @ajay @lina can you grab the runner logs + profile?

ajay: Pasting the relevant snippet from eval-runner-3 logs:
```
[2027-07-12T14:05:21.123Z] shard=7 lease=4200ms acquired
[2027-07-12T14:05:26.561Z] shard=7 enqueue timeout after=5000ms task=quant-warmup
[2027-07-12T14:05:26.562Z] shard=7 lease expired while queued
[2027-07-12T14:05:26.563Z] shard=7 reassigning to runner-5
```

maria: Also saw aggregator flakiness: `latency_p95` was NaN for a couple of runs because `count == 0` slipped through a reduce. I opened a tiny fix in PR #214 to guard division by zero.

lina: I've pushed a hotfix branch that extends shard lease to 12s and increases enqueue timeout for canary runs. Also added extra debug logging around lease/queue events. Can run canary now.

ci-bot: CI: rerun #4572 triggered for `eng-ml/13b-quant/onboard` with extra logging. https://ci.redwood/example/4572

dave: Short-term mitigations: 1) prevent autoscale-down mid-run (we're seeing workers removed during long quant warmups), 2) increase max_lease_ms, 3) add pre-warm for KV/quant on first assignment.

sara: @dave @ajay please attach the perf flame/pprof and the metric graph for shard-7 to the ticket. I'll escalate to platform if canary still shows reassignment.

ajay: Perf counters show syscall spikes during quantize pass (lots of mmap/fadvise on first model load). Snippet:
```
syscall	count
mmap	128
fadvise64	64
open	40
```

maria: Also, the eval harness reported a retry storm after reassignment — we need a softer backoff in the dispatcher to avoid thundering requeues. PR idea: exponential backoff with jitter and a small max retry cap per-request.

lina: Canary deploy starting to show improvement: queue occ on shard-7 down to ~45% after hotfix, no immediate lease expirations in the last 5m. Will keep it running for 30m.

ci-bot: Deploy succeeded to canary group `eng-ml-canary-2` (build 2027.7.12-89) :white_check_mark:

sara: Good. Keep alerts on. If stable after 30m we should merge the hotfix and add a follow-up to harden scheduler (less aggressive requeue + KV pre-warm + fix aggregator NaN).

dave: I'll open a roadmap ticket for the scheduler changes and attach notes from today's debug.

sara: Thanks all — tagging SRE if anything flips: @dave @lina. Monitoring for the next 30m, then we decide.

maria: Filed bug REDWOOD-ML-2389 with logs and perf.

lina: Adding a smoke check to CI that runs a single quant warmup before enqueuing the shard assignment. Should reduce first-request tail.

sara: Perfect. Update the thread when you see the 30m status.

ci-bot: CI: smoke-check job passed for hotfix branch.

sara: Closing loop — canary looks stable for 30m, merging hotfix to main, follow-up stories for scheduler & aggregator on board. Great triage, team :thumbsup:
